name: Epivoke
summary: Turns a topic or script into a long-form, narrated and animated documentary-style YouTube video ready to upload.
description: Turns a topic or script into a long-form, narrated and animated documentary-style YouTube video ready to upload.

pricing.details: Starter 35 €/month (~20 min of finished video); Pro 88 €/month (~60 min); Studio 222 €/month (~170 min). Yearly billing 20% off (yearly totals not published). Failed videos are refunded; full refund within 7 days if no credits were used.
pricing.label: Premium

features: Long-form narrated and animated documentary-style YouTube videos (8–60 min)
Script writing and review, with 20 free rewrites per video
Visuals chosen line by line from licensed stock and archives
